sentences.text: Hastanectes is an extinct genus of plesiosaurian with possible affinities to pliosaurids.
The only known species, Hastanectes valdensis, was originally classified as a species of Cimoliasaurus.
Scientists have recorded six fossil occurrences of this animal in the Paleobiology Database.
The genus Hastanectes was described by Benson and colleagues in 2012.
Hastanectes is classified within the family Pliosauridae.
The genus belongs to the suborder Pliosauroidea.
Hastanectes is also classified in the family Leptocleididae.
The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Hastanectes as Leptocleididae.
Fossils of Hastanectes have been found in the Early Cretaceous Wadhurst Clay Formation of the United Kingdom.
Hastanectes lived between 139.1 and 132.6 million years ago, during the Berriasian to Valanginian stages.
